scope: Checked local accepted-job authority, exact native retirement, reload dispatch guards and context-bound run-watch preference synchronization
source_qualification: Canonical tests ran against the working source committed as this revision. Native executable version metadata may retain the pre-commit revision; SHA-256 identifies actual checked artifacts. No production release was installed.

results.go_packages: all passed; environment-gated external integrations remain separate

ui_artifacts.tree_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted relative file path UTF-8 + NUL + raw file SHA-256 bytes + newline for each ui/dist file

preserved_boundaries: Production Agent-C daemon/gateway remained inactive and disabled; dedicated PostgreSQL remained exited restart=no. No cloud-model or real-provider probe.
Pre-existing docs/PUBLISHING.md, private .config/ and local AGENTS.md/PANDA_PUSH.md remain outside the source commit.
limitations: Accepted pins never expire/evict, but only 64 entries fit. A 65th accepted scope fails closed and retains its submission receipt.

Retired markers outrank hints but expire after seven days or can be evicted under capacity pressure. Removed history cannot suppress stale remote hints; those hints permit only read-only native recovery.
Metadata synchronization is best effort. A timed-out/aborted preference POST can still commit remotely; this is not server write-order, cross-tab/device admission or content idempotency.
Native/browser fixtures use temporary daemons, loopback model stubs and intercepted transport; no hardware, physical input, live provider or deployment qualification is implied.

The separate core-only and repeated session-store lanes were not repeated for this client-only change; prior results remain in consolidation-20261120.json. Hosted platform CI and optional external PostgreSQL integration were not rerun.

documentation_check.method: Local helper verifies relative Markdown destinations and GitHub-style heading fragments after excluding fenced examples. The helper lives in ignored build/check_watch_docs.py; canonical fresh-clone verification remains tools/verify_current_snapshot.sh.
